metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. KODAK motion picture film technical data sheet H-1-5279 (1996-03), 5279.pdf, PDF page(s) 2;3, KODAK VISION 500T Color Negative Film 5279 / 7279: https://125px.com/docs/motionpicture/kodak/5279.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): mid-scale neutral and D-min dye densities borrowed from kodak_vision_500t_5263 (VISION 500T, H-1-5263tx; not on this sheet); sensitivity density (0.2 above D-min), densitometry (Status M) and exposure time not printed: assumed as on the VISION 320T sheet of the same edition; spectral sensitivity on the sheet's log scale, absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; individual C/M/Y dye curves printed peak-normalised: used as the start of the builder's dye reconstruction against the printed mid-scale neutral and D-min; dye densities outside the printed wavelength range; print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; the contemporary 5386 / 2386 / 2393 era prints are not modelled separately); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives); hanatos2025 adaptation parameters borrowed from the shipped Kodak negatives (pinned donors). Original data are property of the respective holders.
